question: Who among the following is known as the 'father of Indian Supercomputers'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijay Bhatkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vijay Bhatkar** is widely known as the 'father of Indian Supercomputers'.
 
• He led the development of the **PARAM series of supercomputers** in India.
 
• The PARAM 8000, developed in 1991, was India's first indigenous supercomputer.
